run_common_auth_checks: run common auth checks for jwt and key-based authentication including model access, budget, and route permissions
get_key_object: get a key object from cache or database by hashed token with automatic caching
get_team_object: get a team object from cache or database by team id with automatic caching
get_user_object: get a user object from cache or database by user id with automatic caching and optional upsert
check_team_model_access: check if a team can call a specific model with access group fallback support
generate_ui_jwt_token: generate an encrypted JWT token for experimental UI login with 10-minute expiry
generate_cli_jwt_token: generate an encrypted JWT token for CLI authentication with configurable expiration hours
check_allowed_routes: check if a user role is allowed to access a specific route based on jwt role permissions
get_end_user_object: get an end user object from cache or database with default budget application and budget check
check_tools_allowlist: check if requested tools are in the allowed tools list for the key or team metadata
